notes: Proposal for the strategy gate. The Rust harness reports an Err's category as its type name (last path segment), so one public error enum, compare_versions_port::Error, reports 'Error' for every failure. Suggested variants: InvalidVersion(String) for "Invalid argument not valid semver ('<input>' received)" and InvalidOperator for "Invalid operator, expected one of >|>=|=|<=|<|!=", whose Display impl reproduces the source text so messages compare exactly. The source's TypeError paths are 'Invalid argument expected string' and 'Invalid operator type, expected string but got <typeof>' (only reachable with non-string arguments, all in cases named *nonstring*), plus four V8-generated messages in satisfies (ignore-message). Through a &str API they are unreachable; if the strategy keeps them, a variant such as InvalidType with the same Display text covers them under this same mapping. A port that wants EXACT instead of EQUIVALENT can name its types TypeError and Error and drop this map.
